title: North Dakota Century Code Chapter 49-04 - Duties of Public Utilities
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 49 chapter index (https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t49.html): title 'Title 49 - Public Utilities', chapter row '49-04' with name 'Duties of Public Utilities', no '[Repealed]' marker (siblings 49-08, 49-10, 49-18 and 49-17.2 are marked [Repealed]); then fetched https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t49c04.html, which lists sections from 49-04-01. Currency: 07/01/25 update, 69th Legislative Assembly.
notes: The statutory service and charging duties of public utilities; rate-setting powers sit in ch. 49-02 (Powers of Commission Generally) and ch. 49-05 (Procedure on Regulation of Public Utilities), and metering offences in ch. 49-04.1. Much of the operative billing, deposit and disconnection detail is in Public Service Commission administrative rules (N.D. Admin. Code title 69) rather than in the statute.
